an3.80:2.2: “Sir, I have heard and learned this in the presence of the Buddha:
an3.80:2.3: ‘Ānanda, the Buddha Sikhī had a disciple named Abhibhū. Standing in the realm of divinity, he could make his voice heard throughout the thousandfold galaxy.’
an3.80:2.4: I wonder how far a Blessed One, a perfected one, a fully awakened Buddha can make their voice heard?”
an3.80:2.5: “He was a disciple, Ānanda. Realized Ones are immeasurable.”
